user_goal: 部署自动化：GitHub Actions workflow 手动触发 prod 部署，含 pre-deploy DB 备份 / migration deploy / PM2 zero-downtime reload / health check 重试 / 失败自动回滚；Definition of Done = 用户在 GitHub UI 点 Run workflow 5-10 分钟内 kol.guangai.ai 跑新版

session_notes.Kimi: BI2 部署自动化 planning 完成（Option α infra-first 序列第三棒）。8 features 按依赖顺序强制执行：F001 /api/health → F002 PM2 → F005 healthcheck → F004 backup → F006 rollback → F007 ROLLBACK SQL 校验 → F003 deploy workflow → F008 runbook。spec 已完整（docs/specs/BI2-deployment-automation-spec.md，2026-04-18 起草 + 2026-04-20 确认范围）。Planner 在 Generator 开工同时并行准备前置条件：VPS 工具安装（jq/pg_dump/certbot）+ 生成 deploy 专用 SSH key + GitHub Environment production + required reviewer + 3 个 Secrets（PROD_HOST/PROD_USER/PROD_SSH_KEY）。前置条件仅阻塞 F003 真实 deploy 验收，F001-F002/F005/F004/F006/F007/F008 可不等。BI1 sprint 历史见 commit 361e14a 之前所有 BI1-* commits；Framework v0.9.1 新增 database-patterns.md + pre-impl-adjudication.md §9.1 Planner 写 spec 自检清单。pre-impl 审计 → Planner 裁决模式继续适用，johnsong 如遇 spec 歧义先发审计请求。
session_notes.johnsong: BI2 F001 done — src/app/api/health/route.ts（Next Route Handler, runtime=nodejs, dynamic=force-dynamic）返回 status/version(来自 package.json)/git_sha(GIT_SHA env fallback 'unknown')/uptime_seconds/checks{database,redis}/timestamp；DB check 用 prisma.$queryRaw SELECT 1 + performance.now() 测 latency；加 1500ms Promise.race 超时防 PG 不可达时 Prisma 自己 hang 134s（spec SLA <200ms 在 unhealthy 路径下也必须 fast-fail 给 scripts/healthcheck.sh 3s×5 循环预算）；redis stub 返回 {status:'stub', note:'wired in B5 with BullMQ'}；任何 check fail → HTTP 503 + status:'unhealthy'。middleware.ts matcher 已排除 /api，天然 skip auth。tests/route.test.ts 4 cases mock @prisma/client（同 BI1-F006 class PrismaClient pattern）覆盖 healthy/DB-throws/GIT_SHA override/cache-control=no-store。本地验证：healthy 31ms (DB 2ms) / DB down 1.54s / recovery 30ms。test:unit 87/87 / test:integration 28/28 无回归。下一棒 F002 PM2 ecosystem.config.js。
